The defence rests on magician society membership: a membership the society renews after performed illusions. The price is per head, and the violet test proves it: Forging 294 of these means fabricating 294 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. The delta trail is public, the lagoon check is cheap to run, and a farm of 294 aliases pays 294 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
